rationale: Ground truth is nearly empty (LGTM plus a tangential ask to split out a VoxCPM2 regression fix); Y explicitly validates that VoxCPM2/#4963 is out of scope and tracked separately, directly matching the one real reviewer concern, while X never mentions VoxCPM2 at all. Y's claims are also more visibly grounded (explicit [validated] tags with quoted PR-time-tree evidence) versus X's much larger volume of highly specific but unverifiable technical claims (exact FlashInfer/aiter line ranges, docs line numbers, invented follow-up items) that read as scope creep for a 2-line YAML diff the actual reviewers rubber-stamped. X is far more actionable with concrete code/comment suggestions, but that doesn't offset its miss on the only real ground-truth signal and its riskier precision.
